summary: Taseko Mines Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer report) attaching a press release about its upcoming annual general meeting (AGM), which includes a proposal to change the corporate name from Taseko Mines Ltd. to Trekor Metals Ltd., subject to shareholder vote. No financial terms, price, premium, or transaction consideration are disclosed. The board unanimously recommends voting FOR all resolutions. This is a routine AGM circular/notice requesting approval of name change, director elections, auditor appointment, and say-on-pay. No special-situation transaction or extraordinary event is announced. What to watch: shareholder vote outcome on June 24, 2026.
